title: Extraction of DNA from Blood Samples Using QIAamp DNA Mini Kit
author: Qiagen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ihfcb3n

steps.title: Lyse blood sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis mixture, vortex, incubate, and briefly centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µl Qiagen protease to a 1.5 ml micro‑centrifuge tube.
Add 200 µl whole blood to the same tube.
Add 200 µl Buffer AL and mix by pulse vortexing for 15 seconds.
Incubate the tube in a water bath at 56 °C for 10 minutes.
Briefly centrifuge the tube to remove drops from the inside of the lid.

steps.title: Add ethanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add ethanol, vortex, and briefly centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl 100 % ethanol to the lysate and mix by pulse vortexing for 15 seconds.
Briefly centrifuge the mixture.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer mixture to spin column and centrifuge to bind DNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mixture carefully into a QIAamp Mini spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube, avoiding wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 1 minute.
Discard the flow‑through tube.

steps.title: Wash column with AW1
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash of the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column in a clean 2 ml collection tube and discard the previous tube.
Add 500 µl Buffer AW1 without wetting the rim.
Close the cap and centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 1 minute.
Discard the collection tube containing the filtrate.

steps.title: Wash column with AW2
steps.instruction: Perform the second wash and dry spin.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube.
Add 500 µl Buffer AW2 without wetting the rim.
Centrifuge at 14 000 rpm for 3 minutes.
Discard the collection tube containing the filtrate.
Place the spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube and centrifuge at 14 000 rpm for 1 minute (dry spin).

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute DNA from the spin column and store.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column in a clean 1.5 ml micro‑centrifuge tube.
Add 200 µl Elution Buffer (AE) and incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 8 000 rpm for 1 minute.
Discard the spin column.
Store the eluate (DNA) at –80 °C.
